hook: A half-god boy fighting the Heroic Games to free his imprisoned father.
plays: Mounted lord: spear rider from Ch 5, mounted caster (Caladrius) from Ch 10
pick: You like a warm, helping-people story and a gentle ramp into the systems.
watch: Can't enter the Nysiades Desert in Part I. Orchel's Paralogue window is only 10/18–10/20.
why: Arrives with Guardian and Ranger from Dietrich. Unlocks the reliable Dragoon and Troubadour.

team.summary: Part I deploys a core of eight (Cai, Tialla, Peter, Guzran, Noctula, Ultand, Seteth, Ninae) plus Sirocco once he joins (late Ch 10 or Ch 11); Majide, Nydine, Jasmine, Peppe, Mikaela and Fianna stay on the bench. Ultand goes Diviner, Shaman, Ovate, so from late Ch 7 the army runs two Physic healers (Tialla, Ninae) and two casters (Cai, Ultand), and Sirocco takes over as the main nuke once he joins. Eight units take an Advanced class before Part II: Tialla (Bishop), Cai (Caladrius), Guzran (Shido) and Ultand (Ovate) in Ch 10, Seteth (Dragoon) and Ninae (Guardian) in Ch 11 to 12, Sirocco (Ovate) in Ch 12 and Fianna (Troubadour) if she makes Lv 35. Late recruits join scaled (about Lv 15 in Ch 6 to 9, about Lv 25 in a Specialty class from Ch 10). Benched units train ranks in the Arena and take any missing exams on Part II's free Licenses.
gaps: Mastery speed is undocumented (one GameFAQs player says it is much quicker than Three Houses). If a mastery is slow, cut the side trip, not the main class.
Ultand's Black Magic is not a preferred rank: Black Magic C by Lv 20 and B by Lv 35 rely on doubled Shaman casts plus weekly Mage Training.
Shaman and Armored Ornius Rider Skill EXP rows look swapped in the sources; Cai's and Ultand's Shaman stints rely on casting to train Black Magic (unverified).
Whether two Barrier users (Tialla, Ninae, Ultand, Fianna) stack on one ally is not documented.
Mount bonds: Paired Run's bond 3 and bond 5 steps come from one video; whether a bond carries to a new mount is not documented. No Part I Bau catch is confirmed for the Dragoons.
Mentoring: no local source lists any mentor skill beyond the item and class rewards.
Noa Fruit (Ninae's Hexlock Shield barter) has no documented source.
Benched units can only train ranks in the Arena (2 to 3 units per course, each course once a week). Mage Training is now crowded: Cai (Ch 5 to 9), Ultand (Ch 6 to 10), Fianna (Ch 10 on).
Deployment slot counts are a player report; check the prep screen.
fixes: Ch 5: start Gauntlet use for Guzran (no Arena course trains it); Axe and Sword training for Noctula; Black Magic for Cai.
Ch 6: Ultand takes Diviner, not Soldier, and books Mage Training every week for Black Magic C.
Ch 7: Cai Shaman (Black Magic B for Caladrius), Guzran Pugilist (Attack, Get Back), Ultand Shaman (second caster).
Ch 10: Ultand Ovate once Black Magic is B; Sirocco becomes the main nuke once he joins (late Ch 10 or Ch 11).
Farming: plant 30 Linaria, 40 Coffee Berries/Zang/Pongo (10 Pongo for Archive T), and Melara and Shaktoh past the Ch 8 quest count for Ultand's Iron Gauntlets and Noctula's Phantom Ring.
Stable: Cai's Ornius bond 5 by Ch 8; Seteth's Meganius bond 3 by Ch 8; Peter's horse from Ch 7. Bench mounts and the spare horses for Cai and Tialla in the Stable by the end of Ch 12.

Bench Arena plan: Heavy Training for Jasmine, Majide and Nydine (Axe, Spear, Heavy); Mounted for Nydine, Mikaela and Fianna (Rider, Flying); Mage for Ultand and Fianna; Infantry for Peppe, Mikaela and Majide (Bow, Sword).
Part II Specialty Licenses: Ch 1 Nydine (Armored Ornius Rider) and Mikaela (Archer), plus any join class that came out wrong; Ch 2 Majide (Brigand); Pugilist for Majide once Gauntlet is C.

Part II Advanced Licenses: Ch 1 slipped Part I exams, then Cai Bardinger and Tialla Troubadour; Ch 2 Nydine Dragoon, Jasmine Dreadnought, Fianna Troubadour, Peter Sniper; Ch 3 Mikaela Forest Knight, Peppe Ranger, Seteth Guardian, Ninae Bishop; Ch 4 Ultand Bishop, Fianna Bishop.
Part III: Ninae Sentinel and Mikaela Bow Adept while their temple requests (Aurora, Kalla) are pending; Ultand Druid; Cai Orichaldia before The Cavalier.
Turn on the Increase Class EXP boon (after Dietrich's path): every side trip here waits on a mastery.

deployment.summary: Cai's Part I core is Cai, Tialla, Peter and Guzran from Ch 1 to 5, plus Noctula and Ultand from Ch 6, Seteth and Ninae from late Ch 7 (Renown 6) and Sirocco from late Ch 10 or Ch 11 (Renown 9). The change is Ultand: she goes Diviner, Shaman, Ovate instead of Guardian, so from late Ch 7 the army runs two healers (Tialla and Ninae, both with Physic) and two casters (Cai and Ultand) instead of three healers and one caster. The army is built around a dodge-tank pocket (Noctula with Ultand's Pray for Safety and Ninae's Spirits' Guidance beside her), a Charge lane (Seteth holds, Peter charges) and Tialla's range-2 Lend Magic on the casters. The route mechanic shapes it through bonded mounts for the mounted strike team (Cai, Peter, Seteth), Kindness Quest Renown that times every exam, and crops that pay for the shields and rings in the builds.

phases.note: Only four units exist before Ch 6, so everyone fights (Guzran from Ch 3). Tialla is the only healer; guests help: Ultand in Ch 3, Theodora and Orchel in Ch 4, Dietrich and Anatolia in Ch 5.

Ultand fills the caster role from her first map; Seteth and Ninae join at Renown 6 (late Ch 7). Ch 9: Ultand is out, so Noctula takes her slot and Cai (Shaman) casts. On 7-slot maps Noctula sits once Ninae joins.

Ch 10: Fianna (about Lv 25) borrows the ninth slot until Sirocco joins (Renown 9, late Ch 10 or Ch 11). Then Sirocco is the main nuke and Ultand (Ovate) plays support caster beside Noctula. Anna's Paralogue has a smaller roster: bring Tialla or Ninae and an armor-killer (Cai, Ultand or Sirocco).

synergies.title: Dodge-tank pocket
synergies.how: Noctula baits enemy phase from a forest or thicket. Ultand ends beside her: Patch Up heals her after every enemy-phase fight, and Pray for Safety adds Ddg +10 (+20 at Lv 35), which stops crits, not hits. Ninae takes the other side: Spirits' Guidance gives Noctula Hit/Avo +10 against mages (her Res grows 20%).
synergies.payoff: Patch Up after every fight, Ddg +10 against crits (+20 at Lv 35), Hit/Avo +10 against mages

synergies.title: Lend Magic at range 2
synergies.how: Tactician's Wit adds range to Tialla's Lend arts: Lend Magic (Authority C) on the caster before it nukes, Lend Strength+ (Authority B) on Guzran. Train Authority in her Mage Training seat.
synergies.payoff: Tialla buffs from 2 tiles away, so she never stands where the nuke's target can reach her

synergies.title: Charge lane
synergies.how: Seteth plugs the choke on enemy phase (Ready for Battle, Sense Threat, Silver Shield and Gale Ring: 6 extra weight, so he isn't doubled). Next turn Peter Charges down the line of foes stacked in front of him.
synergies.payoff: Charger gives Peter Prt +10 (the chariot can't dodge); one Charge hits the whole stacked line

synergies.title: Crescendo feed
synergies.how: Guzran and Cai leave targets low so Peter takes the early kills. Crescendo stacks before he swings the Deadeye Longbow.
synergies.payoff: Crescendo Hit +3 per kill (up to +30) cancels the Deadeye Longbow's Hit -30

synergies.title: Two Physic users
synergies.how: Tialla heals from the back with doubled Bishop casts, Ninae from the front as a Priest, then a Guardian. They carry Ch 9 alone while Ultand is out.
synergies.payoff: Two range heals a turn from Ch 8; Ch 9 runs without Ultand and still has both

synergies.title: Mounted strike team
synergies.how: Paired Run on bonded mounts (Cai's Ornius, Seteth's Meganius), Peter's Canto, and Cai's Brio and Overtake let the three hit a flank and pull back out of reach. Nydine joins in Part II.
synergies.payoff: Paired Run Mov +1 at bond 3, +2 at bond 5; Canto and Overtake move again after the hit

synergies.title: Underworld maps
synergies.how: Flamekeeper makes every ally immune to Underworld Flames and halves damage taken in them; Guzran's Cleansing Blade ignores the Underworld boon. Keep the strikers inside Cai's flames.
synergies.payoff: No Underworld Flames damage, half damage inside them, and Guzran ignores the Underworld boon

Seteth.partII: Chases the Ch 2 Ranger with Nydine; Guardian stint in Ch 3 for Brace.

Ninae.partII: Bishop stint in Ch 2 to 3 for doubled Physic on the Ch 3 map.

Jasmine.partII: Armored Knight? on join, Dreadnought in Part II Ch 2 (Ch 3 if her ranks lag) to hold the chokepoints.

Peppe.partII: Rogue in Ch 1 to 2, Ranger from Ch 3: one of the 3 to 4 bows Ch 4 asks for.

part2.note: Part II takes up to 15 units (one source), so all 15 can fight from Ch 1. Part II has three casters (Cai, Ultand, Sirocco) for the heavy armor ahead. Nydine joins the strike team with Barging Order. If the cap turns out lower, sit Majide first, then Fianna.

mechanics.what: Cai's route quests: 100 to 250 Renown (community-reported) and 550 to 7,000G each. Renown gates every exam and unlock: Specialty exams and Noctula (4), Majide and Mikaela (5), Seteth, Ninae and Nydine (6), Castor's Caladrius request and the Theater (7), Advanced exams, Aurora's Dragoon request, Jasmine, Fianna and the Thermae (8), Sirocco and Peppe (9), Bertrand's request (10).
mechanics.impact: Do each Kindness Quest in the chapter it appears, and deliver the three crop quests (200 to 250 Renown) the day the crops are ready, not on 11/27: that pulls Renown 8 into early Ch 10 for the Advanced exams. Quests that say 'beat X at Y' are extra fights (up to 6 units): send the late joiners (Ultand, then Ninae and Seteth, then Fianna and Sirocco) to catch up levels. Take a god audience whenever a temple shows gold on the map (about +50, no Turn). Clear the Ch 10 paralogues early (150 each); For the Empire's Safety (Ch 8) pays 200. Generic subquests you finished on Dietrich's route complete themselves here.

mechanics.what: Only Cai plants: crops grow on empty land during exploration and pay the three crop Kindness Quests and many Vandahl barters in Dagsion Port.
mechanics.impact: Plant past the quest counts: 30 Linaria, not 20 (10 pay Ninae's Hexlock Shield). 30 Coffee Berries/Zang/Pongo plus 10 Pongo for Archive T (Ultand). From the Ch 8 crops: 3 extra Shaktoh (Noctula's Phantom Ring) and 6 extra Melara (Ultand's Iron Gauntlets); Melara x20 plus Usamos x10 for Peter's Conflagrant Gem only if Cindered Road Cave is late. Zang x10 plus Oda Monja x1 barters the Da Mina Axe for Majide's Part III kit.

mechanics.what: Cai-only: lure with the family's food (fish for Ornius, vegetables for Horse and Pegasus, meat for Bau; the wrong food starts a battle). Each catch rolls breed (rare about 30%?), paired ability and color. Feed every mount once a day: its favourite taste raises bond fastest, and kills while riding count. A ridden mount adds its growths only while the unit is mounted.
mechanics.impact: Bond 3 and bond 5 upgrade the paired ability (Paired Run: Mov +1, then +2); bond 5 gives the full stat bonus. Roll for Mov (Paired Run, Paired Streak) or Canto and skip Paired Alertness: hard save on the tile, lure, check, and reload if wrong. One mount per rider: Cai a Wild Ornius (Ch 5), Seteth a Meganius and Nydine a Red Meganius (Ch 7 or 8), Peter a Ferghanan (Sunfall Path). Every mount must be in the Stable by the end of Ch 12, bench riders' and Part II stints' included: Mikaela's horse, Fianna's Monoceros, spare horses for Cai and Tialla. Charioteer doubles its mount's growth bonus?

mechanics.what: Cai-only from Ch 4: Cai is the one mentored, and each mentor pays an item or a class. Centurio: Archer's Ring (Ch 4). Castor: Bolt Gem (Ch 5), Caladrius (Renown 7, late Ch 8). Aurora: Healing Staff (Renown 4, Ch 6), Dragoon (Renown 8, Ch 10). Bertrand: Troubadour or an Advanced License (Renown 10, Ch 11). No local source lists mentor skills beyond these rewards.
mechanics.impact: Rewards go to deployed units: Archer's Ring on Peter, Healing Staff on Tialla, Caladrius for Cai in Ch 10. The Bolt Gem waits for benched Majide: equip it at the end of Ch 12; Guzran wears the Bird-Plume Amulet. Dragoon goes to Seteth (Ch 11 or 12) and Nydine (Part II Ch 2): do the Renown 8 request the day it lands, since Renown doesn't carry into Part II. Troubadour goes to Fianna (Ch 12 or Part II Ch 2) and Tialla's Part II stint.

mechanics.what: An Archive is used up when read: its dark spell stays on that unit for good, with no inventory or equipment slot. One copy of each per route. Archive Z (Southern Passage) and Archive L (Aditi's Cave) are in Nysiades, closed to Cai in Part I.
mechanics.impact: Tialla reads B in Ch 8 (Mire Β, Mt 3, range 1-3: chip that sets Tactician's Insight where most foes can't counter). Ultand reads θ in Ch 10 (Banshee Θ: Immobilize a boss or runner from range 3) and T from Vandahl (Dark Spikes Τ: Mt 20, 3x vs cavalry). Sirocco reads Γ if Vandahl stocks it (Death Γ: +10 Mt over his Wind and Thunder). Cai skips them: Thoron, Bolganone and a Ridersbane already cover range, armor and cavalry. Spell weight counts like a weapon: Banshee (23), Dark Spikes (20) and Mire (15) get the caster doubled on a counter, so cast them where the foe can't answer.

mechanics.what: Cai's path is the second one, after Dietrich's: Guardian (Ninae) and Ranger (Peppe) carry in, Blacksmith too (no user). Cai's own mentorships add Caladrius, Dragoon and Troubadour. Cataphract and Dancer aren't available. Only Cai's route has the Stable.
mechanics.impact: Ninae takes Guardian and Peppe Ranger with no unlock quest on this route. Played first instead, Ninae goes Bishop beside Tialla, Ultand stays Ovate and Peppe goes Rogue to Sniper. Every pick, bait and spawn tile is in the Mounts tab (T).

mechanics.system: Side trips and free class switching
mechanics.what: Once certified, a unit switches between its classes for free at the Proctor, the Base Menu or Battle Prep. A side trip costs one License, not the old class. Mastery speed is undocumented.
mechanics.impact: Early units master their Specialty class around Ch 7, then wait for Lv 35 and Renown 8 (usually Ch 10): spend Ch 7 to 9 in a second class for a mastery, a stat fix or an exam rank, then switch back or move on. Every switch waits on a condition ('once Regroup is mastered'), not a fixed chapter: if a mastery is slow, drop the side trip, not the main class. The Increase Class EXP boon speeds all of them.

mechanics.what: Recruits scale to the chapter: Ch 6 to 9 joins arrive at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class, Ch 10 to 12 joins at about Lv 25 already in a Specialty class. Which class each arrives in is ?. A benched unit earns no battle EXP, so it can't reach Lv 20 or 35 in Part I.
mechanics.impact: Recruit every bench unit anyway: Part II takes up to 15 units (one source) and Army Training lifts each to Lv 34 in the class it holds. Check each recruit's class on join and take the planned exam only if it arrived in another one. Train every bench unit's Part II exam ranks by the end of Ch 12, since Part II has no free time and no Arena. At the end of Ch 12, load its Part II kit (6 items at most, healing item included) and keep its mount in the Stable.

mechanics.what: Arena, shrines, gifts, meals, the Pale Raven and Stable feeding cost no Turn: do them every week. Meals, gifts, the Theater and the Thermae are weekly slots, not Turns. Quests finished on an earlier route complete themselves, so most free times end with Turns to spare.
mechanics.impact: Every week: one Arena session (pairs on the Arena sheet, A); pray once per god; one gift per character (the first is a 27G pastry, it only unlocks meals); Sunday: all 3 Inn meals at 150G each, always Cai + 2 targets; feed the Pale Raven (from Ch 4, frontliners first) and every mount (from Ch 5). Watch new support conversations at the Inn as soon as they unlock: some chains lock if you wait. Spare Turns, in order: gather the next Vandahl barter materials, run the suggested dungeon with this week's meal pairs (Link attacks raise Support), then hand the rest to Inn Auto-Activities. Dungeon enemies come back every chapter; chests open once.
